## Description

Provide a summary of the changes and the reasoning behind them.

## Related Issues

Closes # (issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring (code improvements with no behavior changes)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:

- [ ] My code follows the guidelines in AGENTS.md
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (README.md / README_RU.md) accordingly
